a modified generalized integrators based controller with reduced number of integrator is presented to estimate fundamental active components of distorted signal.

the proposed SPVA UPQC with the modified GI controller can provide better PQ improvement in comparison to the existing techniques.

the design of an effective controller for SPVA UPQC to mitigate the PQ problems.
